author: (Bruguière, 1792)

note.en: A small white bubble snail with spiral dark bands and a pink or purple body, known here from one specimen collected at about 15 m off the Cahuita to Punta Uva coast in 1998.
note.es: Un caracol burbuja pequeño y blanco con bandas espirales oscuras, conocido aquí por un ejemplar recogido a unos 15 m en la costa entre Cahuita y Punta Uva en 1998.

evidence: GBIF: 1 museum specimen, about 15 m, 1998 (Atta dataset)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and distribution
